AC02

Growing from soil, emerging through heavy pine duff, on upland, mixed Bur Oak/Ponderosa Pine woodland slope in spring branch canyon.
Nearby Trees: Bur Oak, Eastern Red Cedar, Ponderosa Pine, and Ironwood.

Smell: spermatic
Taste: not distinctive
